subject: Meridian Labs: bakeoff results, expansion ask, and retention proposal
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita@meridianlabs.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Kellogg <tkellogg@vertigo.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian bakeoff feedback + next steps

Connor —

Thanks again for running the bakeoff with our data last week. The team finished combing through results and I attached the CSV with the key metrics (latency P95, cost per 1M tokens, hallucination checks). High level takeaways:

- Vertigo showed lower list price for high-throughput token generation (we saw ~12% lower cost on their quote).
- Your latency at our 2k sequence profile met the P50 target but P95 still spikes under sustained bursts (we included the traces).
- Quality is comparable; our ML lead flagged a couple of prompt regressions we want to validate.

We are evaluating two asks from the product team for renewal+expansion:
1) A committed-capacity uplift (we plan to double active tokens next quarter) — need predictable unit economics
2) A 12–18 month price and latency commitment (SLA or credits if P95 exceeds threshold)

Procurement also wants visibility into SOC 2 artifacts and a redline-friendly term sheet. Can you put together a retention offer with a clear uplift pricing tier + short benchmark run (our dataset slice) before next Tuesday?

I copied procurement for logistics.

Appreciate it —
Anita Shah
Head of Applied AI
Meridian Labs

Attachment: meridian-bakeoff-results.csv
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian bakeoff feedback + next steps

Anita —

Thanks for the thorough notes and the CSV. We're glad quality lined up; I hear you on the P95 spikes and the procurement asks. We'll move quickly. Proposed immediate plan:

1) Technical follow-up: run a focused 48-hour profiling run using your exact prompt corpus (we'll surface per-worker P95 and KV cache behavior). Requesting the sample slice you mentioned.

2) Commercial: draft an offer for committed capacity with a two-tier uplift discount (20% on incremental committed tokens for the first 6 months, 12% thereafter) + an operational credit for missed P95 targets.

3) Compliance/legal: we'll send SOC 2 artifacts and a redline-ready term sheet (v3 attached).

Can we schedule a 30-minute sync Monday to align on the benchmark slice and the SLA thresholds you want measured? Hannah and Priyom will join for the technical run and commercial framing; Marissa will steward the save plan.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0136

Attachment: redwood-term-sheet-v3.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Meridian save play — data and offer outline

Team — quick internal thread so we're aligned before Monday's call. Key asks from the customer: committed capacity uplift (2x), P95 latency commitment + credits, SOC2 + redline. Competitive pressure from Vertigo on price.

Suggested save components (initial):
- Commercial: 12-month committed uplift at a blended 18% discount on current list for baseline committed, plus an incremental 22% discount on burst commit for first 90 days.
- SLA: if sustained P95 > target for two consecutive weeks, provide one service credit month (applied to next invoice) + free performance tuning sprint (2 engineer-days).
- Operational: 3-week technical validation window; we'll run a targeted benchmark with their dataset. Per-run Jupyter profiling output to be shared.
- Legal/Procurement: provide SOC 2 Type II report, evidence of retention controls, and a redline-friendly term sheet.

Open items I need from you:
- Hannah: propose the performance tuning scope and ETA for executing the targeted benchmark with their dataset slice.
- Priyom: confirm capacity avail and how much reserved we can commit for Q4.
- Marissa: pricing language and concession guardrails (what's our floor on blended rate).
- Marcus: confirm whether we can front-load any free capacity (one free month) for the first billing period.

I want this tight and measurable — low friction for procurement to sign once the benchmark proves parity.

Connor
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Meridian save play — data and offer outline

Connor —

Agree with the structure. A couple of practical notes:
- Keep the SLA credit simple and time-bound (one calendar month credit applied to the billing period following the breach). No open-ended remediation credits.
- Procurement will push for a price cap; limit to a 12-month firm cap tied to committed tier only. Avoid multi-year caps unless exec-approved.
- I'll draft the offer language and three tier options (Conservative / Growth / Aggressive) so we can present tradeoffs on discount vs. commitment term.

Also: we should propose a short success metric checklist for the benchmark (P95 <= X ms, mean cost delta < Y% vs baseline, no regressions on the flagged prompts). I'll pick values after Hannah sends the perf plan.

Marissa
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita@meridianlabs.com>, procurement@meridianlabs.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Offer & next steps: committed uplift + benchmark run

Anita / Procurement —

Per our internal alignment, attached is a concise offer and the benchmark plan we propose to run against your dataset slice. Summary highlights:

- Commercial: 12-month committed uplift (2x baseline throughput) with a blended 18% discount on committed usage; incremental burst capacity gets a 22% discount for the first 90 days. We can cap committed-tier pricing for 12 months.
- SLA: operational credit of one invoice month if P95 exceeds agreed threshold for two consecutive weeks.
- Technical: 48-hour focused benchmark with your slice; deliverables include raw traces, per-worker P95 heatmap, and a post-run tuning log.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II artifacts included; redwood-term-sheet-v3.pdf is redline ready.

We've scheduled the benchmark to start Wednesday morning pending your dataset slice and a signed test NDA (I included the short form in the attached term sheet). Please confirm by EOD Tuesday if the run can proceed Wednesday.

If you'd prefer, we can also offer a single free billing month applied after the first invoice instead of the burst discount (we're happy to present both options).

--
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
